title: Small Interfering RNA in Cardiovascular Disease: A New Frontier in Precision Medicine.
authors: Paruchuri, Kaavya; Busso, Jaiden; Natarajan, Pradeep
journal: Annual review of pharmacology and toxicology
one_liner_zh: 该文综述siRNA在心血管疾病中的治疗应用，虽提及AI序列设计，但核心对象非蛋白质结构计算，不涉及结构预测、构象采样或MD等建模方法，与本课题关系微弱。
abstract: Despite advances in traditional lipid-lowering, antithrombotic, and antihypertensive therapies, cardiovascular disease remains the leading cause of mortality worldwide. Small interfering RNA (siRNA) therapeutics harness the endogenous RNA interference pathway to degrade target messenger RNA, thereby reducing synthesis of disease-associated proteins. Because gene silencing occurs intracellularly and persists beyond circulating drug exposure, siRNA agents result in sustained effects with infrequent dosing. Hepatocyte-directed agents targeting PCSK9, LPA, ANGPTL3, APOC3, angiotensinogen, and transthyretin have demonstrated robust and durable reductions in several measures, including atherogenic lipoproteins, blood pressure, and amyloid precursors. Ongoing trials will determine whether these biomarker effects translate into improvements in cardiovascular outcomes. Key challenges include delivery beyond the liver, long-term safety monitoring, off-target mitigation, and economic considerations. Advances in chemical modification, ligand-directed targeting, artificial intelligence-guided sequence design, and reversal strategies are expanding the therapeutic landscape. siRNA-based interventions hold promise as a precision modality capable of reshaping prevention and treatment across the spectrum of cardiovascular disease.
abstract_zh: 尽管传统的降脂、抗血栓和降压治疗取得了进展，心血管疾病仍是全球死亡的主要原因。小干扰RNA（siRNA）疗法利用内源性RNA干扰途径降解靶标信使RNA，从而减少疾病相关蛋白的合成。由于基因沉默发生在细胞内，并在循环药物暴露后持续存在，siRNA药物可实现长效作用且给药频率低。靶向PCSK9、LPA、ANGPTL3、APOC3、血管紧张素原和转甲状腺素蛋白的肝细胞导向药物，已在多项指标中显示出稳健且持久的降低效果，包括致动脉粥样硬化脂蛋白、血压和淀粉样前体。正在进行的试验将确定这些生物标志物效应是否能转化为心血管结局的改善。关键挑战包括肝外递送、长期安全性监测、脱靶效应缓解以及经济性考量。化学修饰、配体导向靶向、人工智能引导的序列设计及逆转策略的进展，正在拓展治疗领域。基于siRNA的干预措施有望成为一种精准治疗模式，能够重塑心血管疾病全谱系的预防和治疗格局。
